schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema with the tables added. Nothing is saved.

selections.title: Selections
selections.description: Each table read, as the Schema Editor selects it, in the order asked for.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Columns left out or kept in a type the schema's database doesn't have.

400.description: The settings make no connection, or a table can't be held

409.description: The schema already has a table of that name

502.description: The database refused the connection or a query
